note: Translation bench tasks for the code translator (design 2026-11-14 section 3.3): a fixed snippet set across the Tier-1 language pairs (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Bash). Each task carries a reference translation (the validate-mode oracle) and, where the target is executable, fixed test vectors. Scored by catalog/bench/eval_translate.py: (a) a real parse check in the target language, (b) test-vector equivalence where executable. Records land in eval_translate.jsonl, one line per (model, task).

tasks.reference:
fizzline() {
  local n=$1
  if (( n % 15 == 0 )); then
    echo "FizzBuzz"
  elif (( n % 3 == 0 )); then
    echo "Fizz"
  elif (( n % 5 == 0 )); then
    echo "Buzz"
  else
    echo "$n"
  fi
}

def backoff_seconds(attempt, base):
    return base * (2 ** attempt)
